slots.title: Share image: default (also the home page)
where: Share card for every page without its own (planned: app/layout.tsx metadata.openGraph.images + twitter summary_large_image; not wired yet)
slots.css: 1200×630 as delivered; shown 300–600 wide in link previews, some platforms crop toward 1.91:1 or square
slots.crop: Safe area is the centre 1080×566. The left 55% stays dark, calm and nearly empty: the pipeline composites the NASFAQ wordmark and the line 'Every hololive talent is a stock' there. Boards and fans live in the right 45%. Nothing important within 60px of any edge.
slots.lighting: neon: glowing hololive-blue ticker boards are the key light on dark ink; small green up / red down accents on the tiles
slots.fallback: None today: link previews show the page title and description only.
slots.brief: The NASFAQ share card. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11). In the right 45%, a wall of glowing ticker boards recedes to the right: rising candlestick bars and sparklines in hololive blue (#3fb8f5), a few small green up-arrow and red down-arrow tiles, a halftone bloom around the brightest board. Lower right: three or four generic chibi-proportioned fans in hoodies, seen from behind, cheering at the boards with glowsticks and phones. The left 55% is calm dark ink with only faint board glow. Flat graphic shapes, crisp edges, halftone shading, no banding gradients. Bright enough to read as a 300px thumbnail.
slots.notes: No text or logos in the generated art; the wordmark is composited afterwards. To wire: serve at /art/og/default.png, set metadata.metadataBase to the public origin, add metadata.openGraph.images and metadata.twitter.images in app/layout.tsx. Could be composited from the howto-hero master (same trading-floor world) if the pipeline wants to save a generation.

slots.title: 404: off the chart
where: Any unknown URL: app/not-found.tsx → components/site/status-page.tsx, the picture above the '404 / Off the chart' headline
slots.css: 560×350 max (35rem); full width minus the 16px gutters on phones (~340×213)
slots.crop: Self-contained dark panel with hard rectangular edges; do not feather into the page colour (the page is dark ink or light paper depending on theme). Subject (the broken line end and the fan) in the middle third; the headline sits directly below the image.
slots.lighting: neon: the glowing blue price line is the only strong light; everything past the edge falls to black
slots.fallback: Blue-wash halftone placeholder at 16:10; the headline, line and 'Back to the floor' buttons still render.
slots.brief: A dark trading-board grid seen slightly from above. A single glowing hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) price line runs across it from the left and simply stops at a jagged broken edge in the centre-right, beyond which the board drops away into black like a road ending at a cliff. A small generic chibi fan (hoodie, lanyard, no identifying features) stands at the broken end holding a flashlight, peering over the edge. A few loose grid tiles tumble down into the dark. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11), flat shapes, halftone shading, a little lonely but funny.
slots.notes: No numbers or text anywhere. Pairs with site-error (same StatusPage layout and size): draw them as a set.

slots.title: Error page: something broke
where: A page crashed: app/error.tsx → components/site/status-page.tsx, the picture above 'Something broke' and the retry button
slots.css: 560×350 max (35rem); full width minus the 16px gutters on phones (~340×213)
slots.crop: Self-contained dark panel with hard rectangular edges; do not feather into the page colour. Monitor and fan centred in the middle third; the headline sits directly below.
slots.lighting: neon: blue scanline glow from the monitor, a few warning-amber (#f5b83f) sparks
slots.fallback: Blue-wash halftone placeholder at 16:10; the message and retry button still render.
slots.brief: A trading-terminal monitor on a desk, its screen glitched into blue scanlines around one big blank error window. Two fat cables have come unplugged from the back and spark. A generic chibi fan stands beside it holding one cable end in each hand, puzzled, a sweat drop over its head. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11), hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) screen glow, warning amber (#f5b83f) only on the sparks, flat shapes with halftone shading.
slots.notes: No text on the screen. Same size, framing and fan design as site-not-found.

slots.title: Sign in / register: the floor at the opening bell
where: /login and /register → components/auth/auth-form.tsx pitch panel (right of the form; under it on tablets and phones): top of the panel, bleeding to its edges, above 'Every hololive talent is a stock.'
slots.css: 380×214 on desktop; 480×270 on tablets (panel stacks under the form); full width on phones
slots.crop: The top-right ~30% × 50% stays calm (plain boards, no key object): today's top mover is layered there as a 96px reaction (hype) on desktop and tablet. Welcome kit in the lower left and centre. The heading sits directly below the image, so no bright band along the bottom edge.
slots.lighting: neon: monitors lighting up in hololive blue down the row; a warm desk-lamp pool on the welcome kit
slots.fallback: Blue-wash halftone placeholder at 16:9 at the top of the panel; the pitch text and movers list still render.
slots.brief: An invitation onto the floor at the opening bell: looking down a row of trader desks, monitors lighting up in hololive blue (#3fb8f5) one after another, a big ticker board at the far end full of up-arrows, order slips fluttering in the air like confetti. On the nearest desk in the lower left, a welcome kit: a banded stack of play-money bills with a blue diamond stamp, a blank lanyard trader badge and a steaming mug. Dark ink ground (#0a0c11), flat shapes, halftone light, hopeful mood.
slots.notes: The welcome kit (banded bills with a diamond stamp, blank lanyard badge) must match home-welcome: same props, same design.
